description: Dependency updates, per ADR-0106. Renovate opens the pull request, and the gates decide.
It merges nothing. Every update passes the same lint, drift, and test gates as a human PR. A bump that skips them makes the pin useless.
A dependency held back carries its reason on the package rule that holds it. A pin with no recorded reason is treated as unreviewed.

packageRules.description: One repository has one dependency graph, per ADR-0101. The single go.mod produces one PR, with minor and patch together.
Bun packages: also one PR for the ecosystem.
One PR for the pinned toolchain file, so a SHA always reproduces its own toolchain, per ADR-0101.

Container images: one PR for the ecosystem, minor and patch together, with tag and digest together, per ADR-0106. A new digest with the same tag is a rebuild of the same version. The PR body carries both, because a reviewer cannot judge it from the diff alone.
Helm chart releases: one PR for the ecosystem, minor and patch together, per ADR-0106.
Terraform moves on its own, slower schedule.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: The template pin is a normal dependency, per ADR-0106. The same weekly mechanism proposes the bump, and the same gates check it.

The inner loop's local stand-ins in infra/local/*.yaml: Postgres, the Temporal dev server, OpenFGA, and the API mock. They get one PR, because together they are the floor an engineer runs against, per ADR-0600. None of them is deployed anywhere.
A pin adds a digest or an exact version to a reference that has none. It does not change what runs, so all pins share one PR, per ADR-0106.
A major version is a decision, so it is proposed alone, never joins a group, and opens only after a person ticks it on the dashboard, per ADR-0106. This rule is after every group rule, so it wins.
Held at 3.x: postcss depends on nanoid ^3. The root override only lifts the 3.x line to a patched release. A major breaks postcss.

customManagers.description: Copier records the template commit that a generated project tracks. Renovate bumps it, and `copier update` does the 3-way merge, per ADR-0106.

The setup action pins the mise version that CI installs. The tool that reads every other pin is also a dependency, per ADR-0002 and ADR-0106. No manager sees a composite-action input, so the marker comment above the value makes it visible. It is not in the `mise tools` group: that group bumps the tools mise installs, and this bumps mise.

The forge and runner kits pin the release they install on a machine, per ADR-0102. A marker comment above each pin names its image, so the release moves with the same weekly batch as the chart that pins the same Forgejo.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A CVE with a fixed version is proposed at once, outside the batch, and without dashboard approval even for a major. For this class only, the weekly slot is too slow, per ADR-0106 and ADR-0104.
